source_caption_text:
One of Kodak’s most iconic records 😮‍💨🔥

Kodak Black’s “Tunnel Vision” became one of the defining hits of his early career after its release in 2017. Produced by Metro Boomin, Southside, and CuBeatz, the track stands out for its hypnotic woodwind melody, heavy 808s, and dark trap production.

The song became Kodak’s first major mainstream breakthrough, helping establish him as a national rap star. Its music video also drew significant attention for its symbolic imagery and themes surrounding social and racial tensions.

“Tunnel Vision” remains one of Kodak Black’s most recognizable records. Its distinctive production, memorable vocal delivery, and introspective lyrics about his experiences and staying focused through adversity helped cement the song as a standout of the late-2010s hip-hop era.

#kodakblack #hiphop #rap
